target_defect: RIGHT / FRONT TERMINATION — persistent pinch / crease-like convergence and Zebra compression

AXIS_TANGENT_NEUTRAL.description: Freeze local GRIP_AXIS tangent across each analytic turn span; visual geometry uses a C1 straight continuation after u=0.94. No Source control point is edited.

CROSS_SECTION_SYMMETRY_NEUTRAL.description: Remove late thumb/opposite and top/lower asymmetry by pairwise mean blending after u=0.94 while retaining the shared single-pole collapse.

SINGLE_POLE_COLLAPSE_NEUTRAL.description: Freeze the shared termination-envelope amplitude at its u=0.94 value through the diagnostic tail, then collapse only in the final non-authoritative fan from u=0.9995 to the pole.

COMBINED_NEUTRAL.description: Apply axis-tangent neutralization, cross-section symmetry neutralization and late single-pole collapse neutralization together.

decision_question: After R4/R4.1/R4.3 excluded topology density, envelope-exponent tuning and bounded terminal-profile tuning, does the remaining right/front pinch primarily arise from GRIP_AXIS endpoint tangent, asymmetric cross-section evolution, the forced shared single-pole collapse, or their interaction?
boundary: R4.4 uses analytic and rendered counterfactuals only. It changes no authoritative Blender-native Source relation. A structural-insufficiency classification may justify proposing an explicit sparse Source-level termination-cap relation in a later stage, but R4.4 itself cannot create/promote that relation or authorize Candidate/Canonical/Class-A/engineering/manufacturing/ergonomic/Release status.
